# function: appfabric_ingestiondestination

Builds the ARN of an `appfabric` `ingestiondestination`:

```
arn:${Partition}:appfabric:${Region}:${Account}:appbundle/${AppbundleId}/ingestion/${IngestionIdentifier}/ingestiondestination/${IngestionDestinationIdentifier}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
appfabric_ingestiondestination(appbundle_id string, ingestion_identifier string, ingestion_destination_identifier string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `appbundle_id` (String) Value for `${AppbundleId}` in the ARN template.
1. `ingestion_identifier` (String) Value for `${IngestionIdentifier}` in the ARN template.
1. `ingestion_destination_identifier` (String) Value for `${IngestionDestinationIdentifier}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
